dispositionDefinitions.directly_mapped: The SDL carries the named field, object, input, list, enum, or reusable type relation. JSON Schema still validates instances.
dispositionDefinitions.outside_projection: The source constraint belongs to a concern outside this bounded interface.
dispositionDefinitions.represented_by_directive: An authored GraphQL directive carries the constraint as interface metadata.
dispositionDefinitions.retained_in_json_schema: JSON Schema retains the executable constraint while the SDL carries the adjacent interface shape.
